description: This source file implements functions related to the creation, initialization, and management of a 'ParamTree' object within the SLAP (Service Logic Aggregation Plane) framework. It includes functions for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the object, as well as setting up specific member functions for parameter handling in the context of the SLAP component.

classes.name: SLAP_DSLH_PARAMTREE_OBJECT
classes.description: A data structure representing the ParamTree object, including function pointers for various parameter operations, and internal member variables such as Oid, container context, and owner context.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapDslhParamtoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new ParamTree object, setting up function pointers and calling its enrollment and initialization routines.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapDslhParamtoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the ParamTree object, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapDslhParamtoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls necessary sub-objects or dependencies required by the ParamTree object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapDslhParamtoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the ParamTree object, setting default values and assigning function pointers for parameter operations.
